decisions.reason: The export-and-upload method changes page deployment only; the primary page's two-panel pricing layout remains unchanged.
Moving the completed page between Kajabi accounts does not change the required instructor-section alignment.
The source specifies how completed work may be migrated to the new account, not whether or when the duplicate landing page must be created.
The migration method does not alter the requirement that the duplicate page omit its pricing section.
Exporting and uploading the page does not change the monthly marker or its required typography.
The account-migration instruction does not change which Q&A box must remain absent.
The deployment method does not change the required coverage or label of the secondary course-content CTAs.
The migration instruction does not change the secondary CTA position or wrapper rule.
The source concerns migration of the completed page and does not alter the content, specificity, or accessibility of the pricing color guide.
Exporting the page to the new account does not itself change the required video media or URL.
The deployment method does not alter the requirement that the bonus section be absent.
The account-migration instruction does not change the required absence of the specified Week 5–6 section.
